description: This file defines the abstract class DBManager, which provides a base implementation for database driver interactions within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting tables and fields, executing queries, managing indices, and handling errors. It acts as an abstraction layer over specific database implementations and incorporates logging, error handling, and query optimization features.

classes.name: DBManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing the common interface and implementation for database driver operations used in SuiteCRM, including schema management, query execution, and error handling.
